name: ideogram
description: Ideogram: generate (4.5 and 3.0), remix, precise edit, inpaint, reframe, upscale, remove background and describe images, saved to a local folder (paid per image)

nodes.title: Generate image (Ideogram 4.5)
nodes.description: Generate images with Ideogram 4.5 (strong typography and prompt fidelity), or edit a source image by prompt ($0.03-0.22 per image by quality). Images are saved to $IDEOGRAM_OUTPUT_DIR

dry_run.description: true: validate and price the request without generating or billing (returns a price quote)

prompt.description: What to generate, or the edit instruction when an image is given (natural language or an Ideogram JSON prompt)

image.description: Optional source image to edit (the first of `images`) (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

mask.description: Optional mask for the source image: black = edit, white = keep (same size as the image) (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

size.description: auto (default), "source" (with an image) or WIDTHxHEIGHT from the supported 1K/2K presets, e.g. 1024x1024, 2048x2048

quality.description: very_low (with a source image only), low, medium or high (default high without, medium with a source image); priced by quality

magic_prompt.description: Prompt rewriting: auto (default), on or off

num_images.description: Number of images (default 1); each image is billed

enable_copyright_detection.description: Run likeness and logo checks; flagged images come back with is_image_safe false (adds latency)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Generate image (Ideogram 3.0)
nodes.description: Generate images with Ideogram 3.0, with style types, presets, style codes and a style reference ($0.03 turbo, $0.06 default, $0.09 quality per image). Images are saved to $IDEOGRAM_OUTPUT_DIR

dry_run.description: true: validate and price the request without generating or billing (returns a price quote)

negative_prompt.description: What to leave out (the prompt takes precedence)

rendering_speed.description: Speed/quality tier, e.g. TURBO, DEFAULT or QUALITY (priced differently)

magic_prompt.description: Automatic prompt rewriting, e.g. AUTO (default), ON or OFF

style_type.description: e.g. AUTO, GENERAL, REALISTIC, DESIGN, FICTION

style_preset.description: A predefined style preset name (cannot be combined with style_codes)

style_reference_image.description: Optional style reference image (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

num_images.description: Number of images (default 1); each image is billed

enable_copyright_detection.description: Run likeness and logo checks; flagged images come back with is_image_safe false (adds latency)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

num_images.description: Number of images (default 1); each image is billed

nodes.title: Precise edit (Ideogram 4.5)
nodes.description: Change only what the prompt says and copy every other pixel exactly, optionally limited by a mask ($0.008-0.22 per image by quality). Images are saved to $IDEOGRAM_OUTPUT_DIR

dry_run.description: true: validate and price the request without generating or billing (returns a price quote)

prompt.description: The edit instruction, e.g. Change the jacket to red leather. Keep everything else the same.

image.description: Image to edit (max 50 MB; output keeps its size) (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

mask.description: Optional mask: black = edit, white = keep (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

reference_image.description: Optional reference image (product, material, style) to guide the edit (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

quality.description: very_low, low, medium or high (the only price factor)

context_window.description: Region to edit for images over 4.2 megapixels, e.g. none (whole image)

num_images.description: Number of images (default 1); each image is billed

enable_copyright_detection.description: Run likeness and logo checks; flagged images come back with is_image_safe false (adds latency)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
